about: Draft held-out tasks, batch 1. Written before any system runs on them and never used to tune a prompt. Each task has a specification for the judge and three paraphrases; variation comes from wording, not reruns. Author of this batch: the experiment drafter. A second person writes at least a third of the final set without seeing either system's prompts. Each text task has an oracle_plan: the correct plan written by hand, run through OneMeld's executor as an upper bound on plan quality. For adaptive tasks it is the plan without a retry, so it is correct only when the first attempt passes.

revisions.reason: Version 1 could need more images than the profile's max_images of 2: J01 asked for three teapots, A01 allowed two retries, and A04 retried two icons. Version 1 ran once (runs/heldout-b1) and is excluded from results. The rewrite keeps each task's category and intent and changes only the image count.
